reason: Pre-launch non-production Product audit found that Media/Voice relationship tools are real-bound to the existing send-media-stream authority but the current Element composer room's authoritative remote portal identity is not projected across the Product overlay composition boundary. PR #474 is preserved unmerged because it incorrectly assumed RelationshipProjection.matrixRoomId had an authoritative source and permitted selected-relationship fallback. After #475/#476 admitted the exact Element patch path, this successor authorizes the corrected closure: a minimal read-only Element v1.12.25 Room state seam, explicit replay of patch 0013 in the existing Matrix bootstrap, and a fail-closed unique match against the existing Store conversations authority. No new route registry, Matrix client/token surface, backend/IPC authority, or send authority is authorized.

designEvidence: Element v1.12.25 ClientApi.getRoom() wraps the private matrix-js-sdk Room, but the public module Room contract exposes only id, name and last-active timestamp.
Element v1.12.25 already uses sdkRoom.currentState.getStateEvents(...) as a read-only room-state source in the pinned codebase.

mautrix bridgev2 writes the same BridgeEventContent to m.bridge and uk.half-shot.bridge using a dynamic bridge state key; BridgeEventContent carries protocol.id, channel.id and channel.fi.mau.receiver.
Pinned mautrix-whatsapp v0.2607.0 reports protocol NetworkID 'whatsapp' and MakePortalID returns the remote WhatsApp JID as the portal/channel ID.

Yance workspaceRepository projects canonical conversation routeScope fields platform, sourceAccountId, platformContactIdentity and conversationId; Store SYNC_CUSTOMER_CONTEXT preserves those conversation rows in conversations.byId with sessionKey=conversationId.
ProductComposerAccessory already receives authoritative Element props.roomId and projects it transiently to activeMatrixRoomId; experienceSession does not need route persistence.

RelationshipOverlayHost currently sees activeMatrixRoomId but drops it before rendering MediaWorkspace/VoiceWorkspace, while those workspaces expose manual Platform/Account ID/Chat JID/Session key fields.
tools/matrix/bootstrap.js currently explicitly replays Element patches only through 0012, so merely adding 0013 would create a packaging/runtime omission; 0013 must be explicitly replayed after 0012.

digestCanonicalization.pathNormalization: Require exact repository-relative normalized paths, remove duplicates, then sort with JavaScript default Array.prototype.sort().
digestCanonicalization.canonicalText: Join the normalized sorted unique path list with LF and append exactly one trailing LF before hashing.

requiredBehavior: Extend the public Element module Room contract with the minimum generic read-only state-event content seam needed to enumerate state events of a requested event type, including each event state key and content.

Implement the seam only through the existing private sdkRoom/currentState wrapper; do not expose MatrixClient, access tokens, sync control, bridge credentials, timeline mutation or room-state write APIs.
Add pinned Element unit coverage for the new read-only Room seam and update the generated module-api textual API report.
Remain an ordinary replayable textual patch against the pinned Element source.
bootstrapReplay: tools/matrix/bootstrap.js must declare the exact 0013 patch path.
The existing bootstrap must git apply --check and then apply 0013 only after successful 0012 module-delivery replay.
Do not replace explicit patch replay with a broad upstream-patches glob or directory loader.

productContract.authoritativeRoomIdentity: existing experienceSession.activeMatrixRoomId populated from Element composer props.roomId
requiredBehavior: Opening a Product relationship tool from the active Element composer room resolves routing only from that activeMatrixRoomId; selectedRelationshipId is never used as an active-room route substitute.

For the active room, read all m.bridge and uk.half-shot.bridge state events through the new read-only Element module seam, normalize valid bridge identities, and deduplicate equivalent duplicate identity emitted under both event types.

A usable bridge identity contains a normalized protocol.id and channel.id; channel.fi.mau.receiver is included in matching when present. Zero identities, malformed identities or multiple distinct identities fail closed.

Request the existing Store snapshot conversations domain and normalize canonical routes from routeScope/platform/sourceAccountId/platformContactIdentity/conversationId with existing direct-row fallbacks only where the Store row already contains the same authority data.

Match bridge protocol.id to Store platform and bridge channel.id to Store platformContactIdentity; when bridge receiver is present it must match Store sourceAccountId. Exactly one Store conversation may match. Zero or multiple matches fail closed.
The resolved Product route uses Store platform, sourceAccountId as accountId, platformContactIdentity as chatJid, and conversationId/sessionKey as sessionKey.
m.bridge and uk.half-shot.bridge copies of the same portal identity must not create false ambiguity.

RelationshipOverlayHost resolves the route transiently for the current overlay and passes an explicit Product-bound route binding to MediaWorkspace/VoiceWorkspace; route identity is not persisted into experienceSession or a new registry.

In Product-bound mode Media/Voice do not ask the user to copy Platform, Account ID, Chat JID or Session key. Resolved fields are used directly; unresolved/ambiguous routing disables send and surfaces a fail-closed status.
When MediaWorkspace or VoiceWorkspace is rendered outside Product-bound mode, existing standalone manual route controls may remain available.
Existing Media/Voice desktop APIs, sendMediaAsset/sendVoiceArtifact calls and the unique send-media-stream/sendQueue authorities remain unchanged.
forbiddenBehavior: Do not infer the active room from selected relationship, customer focus, search result, display name, most-recent conversation or first conversation.
Do not create a Yance room-to-route registry, mapping table, route cache, bridge proxy, token broker, second Matrix store, second send authority, queue or outbox.
Do not expose or share a high-privilege bridge access token or MatrixClient through the module API.
Do not persist bridge state content or resolved Product routes in experienceSession.
Do not weaken ambiguous/no-match handling or fall back to user-entered internal identifiers in Product-bound mode.
Do not modify backend routes, Electron IPC/preload, runtime authorities, dependency manifests, workflows, WP0 routing policy or send-media-stream authority.

The 0013 patch contract test proves its upstream path set is exact, includes the module API report and pinned Room unit test, and contains no token/client/write seam.
Matrix bootstrap contract proves 0013 is explicitly replayed after 0012 with apply --check before apply.
Product interaction contract proves activeMatrixRoomId is the only room selector for Product-bound route resolution and selectedRelationshipId is not a route fallback.
Store route resolution contract proves conversations domain is used and ambiguous/no-match candidates fail closed.
Media and Voice tests prove Product-bound mode removes manual internal route entry while standalone mode may retain it.
No experienceSession route persistence, backend/electron/runtime/dependency/workflow/routing-policy/send-authority modification is introduced.
